m_2967f3dbef3a.en: Keep the ball in play across five stages with lasers, shields and other powerups.
m_2967f3dbef3a.zh-Hant: 用雷射、護盾和其他道具接住下一次反彈，闖過五個關卡。

m_67aa752c0127.en: Move with your pointer, touch or arrow keys. Tap Launch or press Space to serve. Break bricks for 10 points across five stages with three lives and five minutes. Catch Multiball, Wide Paddle (12 seconds), Slow Ball (8 seconds), Laser (8 seconds) or a Shield that saves one ball. A life is lost when every ball falls.
m_67aa752c0127.zh-Hant: 用滑鼠、觸控或方向鍵移動。點擊發球或按空白鍵發球。在五分鐘內用三條命闖五關，每破一塊磚加 10 分。可接取多球、加寬擋板（12 秒）、減速球（8 秒）、雷射（8 秒），或可救一顆球的護盾。所有球落下才扣一條命。

m_d79ee7b92283.en: Use arrow keys, WASD, swipe or the direction buttons. Each food adds 10 points. Every third food spawns a boost that raises speed from 10 to 15 cells per second for five seconds. Every fifth adds an obstacle, up to 20. Avoid the walls, obstacles and your own body. Fill the remaining board to win.
m_d79ee7b92283.zh-Hant: 使用方向鍵、WASD、滑動或方向按鈕。每顆食物加 10 分。每吃三顆會生成加速道具，拾取後速度從每秒 10 格增至 15 格，持續五秒。每吃五顆增加一個障礙，上限 20 個。避開牆壁、障礙與蛇身，填滿其餘棋盤即可獲勝。

m_b7b055576c8f.en: Private game progress and personal bests save on this device. Signed-in account saves sync privately to Supabase, isolated from guest saves. Guest saves copy to an account only when requested. New signed-in games that support rankings automatically submit eligible completed results. Guests can play without signing in; old local results are not uploaded to rankings. Connect Four and Reversi are local-only matches. Their computer opponents run in a browser worker, and local two-player matches use the same device. Public runs send a versioned action replay to Supabase for verification and publish your current profile name, avatar, result and date. Replays are not public and are not retained after verification. Paused, hidden or restored games continue privately and cannot enter the board. Pending completed submissions stay on this device for retry, isolated by account. Leaderboards are casual and cannot prevent automated play. Game saves can be deleted in Games. Sound defaults to 35% and starts only after a game gesture; mute, volume and Effects preferences remain on this device. Snake and Brick Breaker show the current rules on public leaderboards. Legacy positions can still be finished as private games. Profile pages include qualifying game bests and unlocked milestone badges with dates. Only server-verified Public results count toward the 30 milestones and personal progress; locked milestone progress is visible only to its owner. Historical badges use only provable results.
m_b7b055576c8f.zh-Hant: 私人遊戲進度和個人最佳儲存在此裝置。已登入的帳號存檔會私下同步至 Supabase，與訪客存檔隔離。訪客存檔只在明確要求時複製至帳號。登入後，支援排名的新遊戲會自動提交合格的完成結果。訪客無須登入即可遊玩；舊本機成績不會上傳至排行榜。四子棋與黑白棋只在本機對局；電腦對手在瀏覽器 Worker 中執行，本機雙人則共用同一裝置。公開對局會將附版本的操作重播傳至 Supabase 驗證，並公開目前的個人檔案名稱、頭像、成績及日期。重播不公開，且驗證後不保留。暫停、頁面隱藏或從存檔恢復的遊戲會以私人方式繼續，不能進入排行榜。已完成但待提交的結果依帳號隔離，保留在此裝置供重試。排行榜屬休閒性質，無法防止自動遊玩。可在 Games 刪除存檔。音量預設為 35%，只在遊戲操作後啟用；靜音、音量與效果偏好只保留在此裝置。貪食蛇和打磚塊的公開排行榜採用目前的規則。舊版存檔仍可在私人遊戲中續玩。個人檔案包含合格的遊戲最佳成績，以及附解鎖日期的里程碑徽章。只有經伺服器驗證的公開成績會計入 30 項里程碑及個人進度；尚未解鎖的進度僅本人可見。歷史徽章只根據可證明的結果補發。
